name: Rohaku Stonehoof
summary: Rohaku Stonehoof is a tauren resident of Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Stationed near the starting encampment of Camp Narache, he serves as an early point of contact for young braves beginning their training in service to the tribe.

sections.title: A Guide on the Mesa
sections.body: Standing within the quiet winds of Red Cloud Mesa, Rohaku Stonehoof represents the supportive communal bonds of the tauren tribes. When fresh initiates step forth into the world to hone their martial, spiritual, or primal skills, Rohaku is among the first to acknowledge their readiness. Serving as a recipient for introductory dispatches carried by aspiring adventurers, he directs newcomers along their path to help defend their ancestral grasslands.

faq.answer: Rohaku Stonehoof is a tauren residing on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. He acts as an early contact point for newly awakened adventurers taking their first steps around Camp Narache.

faq.q: What is his role in Mulgore?
faq.answer: He receives introductory missives from novice braves who are directed to report to him as they begin training for their chosen disciplines on Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Where can I find Rohaku Stonehoof?
faq.answer: Rohaku is located on Red Cloud Mesa, the elevated starting territory situated in the southwestern reaches of Mulgore.

angles.text: For young tauren braves stepping onto Red Cloud Mesa, Rohaku is one of the familiar faces who greets and directs initiates on their path to serving the tribe.
